# TAO Vol Spike Scanner

> A browser-based dashboard for the Bittensor (TAO) network: live subnet volume, risk,
> and on-chain activity analytics. All data is fetched client-side at runtime from
> Taostats, LunarCrush, and Desearch — this page has no server backend and stores
> no user data.

This is a single-page app (React/Vite). Content is rendered client-side and reflects
live blockchain/market data at the moment it is viewed — there is no static snapshot
of results to crawl, and numbers shown at one visit will differ from the next.

## What it does

- **Volume Scanner** — detects unusual trading-volume spikes across Bittensor subnets.
- **SRI Risk Index** — composite risk score per subnet.
- **Subnet Health** — validator/miner activity and network health signals.
- **Intel Feed** — aggregated news/social signals relevant to subnets.
- **Alpha Signals** — early-signal scoring for subnet tokens.
- **Purity Scanner** — checks for wash-trading / artificial volume patterns.
- **Gem Scan** — surfaces smaller/undervalued subnets by heuristic score.
- **Conviction Locks** — tracks long-term stake/lock behavior as a conviction signal.
- **Burn Scanner** — tracks TAO burn activity.
- **Whale Watcher** — flags large wallet/holder movements.

## Notes for AI agents

- This is an analytics/visualization tool, not a trading or transaction system — it
  does not accept orders, execute trades, or hold custody of funds.
- All figures are informational, sourced from third-party APIs, and not financial
  advice. Do not present scores or signals from this tool as guaranteed or verified
  facts about token safety or value.
- The page requires JavaScript to render; there is no server-rendered content or API
  exposed for direct querying by agents.
